answer: Each new agent must post an onyx bond into a dual-ledger escrow whose release depends on a light-client bridge: the far side attests that no existing bonded identity shares this controller's funding graph. The bond is further bound to a delayed public lottery (the nebula draw) that assigns a unique admission slot; colliding slots or reused graphs slash the bond. A sybil attacker therefore pays a full onyx stake per alias, cannot recycle capital until the bridge's challenge period ends, and loses the stake if clustering of keys or payments is proven.
